videos.title: How Often do Asteroids Hit the Earth?: Crash Course Geology #20
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
How worried should we be about giant asteroid impacts? In this episode of Crash Course Geology, we’ll learn how to tell an asteroid from a meteorite, what happens when space rocks approach the Earth, and how scientists track potential threats before they reach us.

videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
Does the U.S. need a competitive third party? And would anyone even vote for one? In this episode of Crash Course Big Questions on U.S. Government we’ll investigate why it feels like the U.S. is trapped in a two-party system. The answer comes down to two things – our systems and ourselves.

videos.description:

videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
